summary: Recent History now loads in batches, lock-screen reminders can stay visible, and the future Android/Windows parity plan includes cross-platform sync.

new_features: Added an optional lock-screen reminder that can keep the redose timing reminder visible until gTimer is opened.
minor_improvements: Recent History on the timer screen now loads 10 more records at a time up to 30.
A full History button appears at the end of the recent list and scrolls clear of the bottom menu.
The future Android and Windows parity plan now includes a preferred cross-platform dose-sync model.
